purpose: Teach: 図る/プライバシー/改造/浸透/中野/対照/許諾/質的

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界での地位向上を、本気で、絶対、図る、絶対、ため、絶対、戦略、絶対、見直しましょう
lines.en: Let's seriously review our strategy for advancing our position in the industry.
lines.style: Crisp, professional opening. Forward momentum. Authoritative but not cold. Direct eye contact and clear diction on the main clause.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の、本気で、絶対、プライバシー、絶対、配慮、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're ensuring thorough consideration of employee privacy. Thank you.
lines.style: Measured, respectful response. Professional courtesy underneath. Steady pace, slight pause before gratitude to show sincerity.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本社の、本気で、絶対、改造、絶対、計画、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with the headquarters renovation plan.
lines.style: Purposeful, matter-of-fact. Confident pacing. Sharp articulation of the action verb. No hesitation—this is decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新サービス、本気で、絶対、浸透、絶対、率、絶対、上昇中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The adoption rate for our new service is steadily increasing. Thank you.
lines.style: Calm, positive report. Slight uplift on the progress indicator. Genuine in the thanks—not formulaic. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 中野、本気で、絶対、地区、絶対、開拓、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's push ahead with developing the Nakano area.
lines.style: Direct, authoritative. Brisk tempo. Emphasis on forward motion. Sounds like a leader setting the next milestone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合との、本気で、絶対、対照、絶対、分析、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're conducting detailed competitive analysis. Thank you.
lines.style: Composed, attentive response. Methodical—he's showing due diligence. Thanks feels earned rather than reflexive.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 契約の、本気で、絶対、許諾、絶対、書、絶対、整えましょう
lines.style: Efficient, conclusive. Shorter phrases, tighter delivery. Sounds like the next logical step. Businesslike but not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。改善、本気で、絶対、質的、絶対、にも、絶対、量的にも、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're advancing improvements in both quality and quantity. Thank you.
lines.style: Closing confirmation. Comprehensive listing delivered smoothly. Gratitude lands with finality—this is the capstone. Steady, assured tone.
